text: A new look: a pale jade board on an ink-wash landscape, with the pieces, the river and the page title in a brush-style Kai typeface, red in cinnabar and black in ink. New game has moved into the More menu. Fixed: the last-move mark after leaving a replay or resuming a game.
换了新外观「青玉」：青玉色棋盘配水墨山水背景，棋子、楚河漢界和页面标题改用楷体，红子是朱砂红、黑子是墨色。「新游戏」移到了「更多」菜单的第一项。修复：退出复盘或继续上次的棋局后，「上一手」标记位置不对。
